ValidationRule.description: Account number must be 10 digits for NZD Payment Currency
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Payment_Details_Added_Manually__c, OR(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Payment (EFT)'), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Ticket Refund EFT')), ISPICKVAL(Original_Currency__c, 'NZD New Zealand Dollar'), NOT(ISBLANK(Bank_Account_Number__c)), NOT(REGEX(Bank_Account_Number__c, "^[0-9]{10}$")) )
